# Lead Scraper (Manual GitHub Action)

## 🚀 How to Run

1. Go to:
   GitHub → Your Repository → Settings → Secrets → Actions

2. Add these secrets:

- APIFY_API_KEY  
- OPENAI_API_KEY  
- GOOGLE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT (paste full JSON)  
- GOOGLE_SHEET_ID  

3. Run manually:
   GitHub → Actions → Lead Scraper (Manual Run) → Run Workflow
